title: Burn marks on the northeast side of the Colossi of Memnon

tellings.quote: stone statues in the world called the colassi of mnon and they have burn marks only on the northeast side

plain: A researcher of ancient history named Matt LaCroix talks about the Colossi of Memnon, a pair of giant ancient stone statues in Egypt. He says they have burn marks only on their northeast side. He tells it as a clue that some great event, possibly a disaster around 12,000 BC, once struck them from one direction.
